title: Equation of Sphere with Given Diameter Endpoints
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the standard equation of the sphere that has the line segment joining A(1, 2, 3) and B(5, 6, 7) as a diameter.

steps.title: Compute Center as Midpoint of Diameter
steps.explanation: The midpoint of any diameter is the center of the sphere.

steps.title: Compute the Radius
steps.explanation: Compute square of Euclidean distance from center C to endpoint A.
